name: Local Optimization with Regularization and Silhouette Fitting
definition: A local vertex displacement step that improves mesh quality (regularization) and fits the mesh surface to the volumetric input data (silhouette fitting) using spring-like forces and EDT-based pushing forces.
summary: This method refines tetrahedral meshes by simultaneously applying regularization and silhouette fitting forces to recover non-rigid details and improve mesh quality during the refinement phase.
